column1: # key.tsv -- Digby-cabinet key no. 129 as reconstructed by A. Aymeloglu, github.com/aaymeloglu/unsolved-ciphers commit d2800bb2 (27 Sept 2026),
# royalist-1646/key129.txt (no licence; values quoted with attribution, grades and source column added here, LIKELY-9 2 Oct 2026, rule 4).
# Grades are conditional on his transcription (rule 2: no image of f.77 or of Evelyn's page scans on disk in this session):
#  H  f77   name read from the surviving key page BL Add MS 72438 f.77 (names 559-580)
#  H  evelyn word read from Nicholas's interlinear decipherment of the King's letters of 24 June / 16 Aug 1646 in the same cipher, Evelyn, Diary and Correspondence (1857) iv 178-179 (page scans)
#  M  evelyn-align letter homophone from a 'loose interlinear alignment' of Evelyn's spelled words (Aymeloglu's own wording)
#  M  unsourced value in key129.txt whose source the README does not name (not in its Evelyn list, not a f.77 name)
#  M  doubtful marked ? by Aymeloglu
#  I  context fixed from f.10's own context ('your Majesty' after [May it please your Matie])
# Not included: 370 = 'tion' (a commented guess in key129.txt from 'd i r e c 370' twice, not a fixed value).
# Regraded 2 Oct 2026 (GAPS-intercepted-royalist-1646, account-4) against Evelyn iv 178-179 read from archive.org diarycorresponde41evel
# leaves 185-186 (NOT 186-187): the item's djvu.xml word boxes, evelyn/align_evelyn.py -> evelyn/gloss_align.tsv. Conditional on
# that OCR (rule 2): the page image of p.179 (leaf_n186.jpg) is on disk, p.178 (leaf 185) is not; neither has been vision-read.
#  C  evelyn-ocr      gloss word (or one letter of a spelled word whose figure count equals its letter count) sits over this figure, OCR digits equal the key's
#  C  evelyn-ocr-seg  'desire' spans 141:56:63:17:67 (6 letters, 5 figures); 67 = e from 'Cabinet' forces 141 = de and 56 63 17 = s i r
#  H  evelyn          gloss confirms the position but the OCR digit string differs from Aymeloglu's reading of the scan (422 read 122, 162 read 102): image decides
#  I  evelyn-ocr-H.   the print reads 'H.' after 'Marq:'; 'Hertford' is the expansion
#  M  evelyn-ocr-span the gloss spans this figure and more (nor over 269:17; having over 200:216; Southampton over 356:84:107:43:282, OCR 85G)
#  M  evelyn-align-unreached  69 does not occur on either page's OCR
#  M  evelyn-ocr-new  'were' sits over 111 (dx +6, p.178) but 111 beside 112 = and breaks the key's alphabetical run; image decides
# Not included: the OCR-garbled figures under 'Cabinet' a/t, 'burned' (at ad 19 if 147) and 'Jewells' (in no 418 56): image needed.
# Regraded again 2 Oct 2026 (GAPS2-intercepted-royalist-1646, account-4) from the page images of pp.178-179 (leaf_n185.jpg fetched
# this session, leaf_n186.jpg): two blind vision passes (evelyn/pass_img_p178.tsv, pass_img_p179.tsv), gaps2/regrade_from_image.py.
#  C  evelyn-img      the gloss sits over this figure on the page image and the digits read from the page equal the key's
#  C  evelyn-img-seg  s i r from 'desire' over 141:56:63:17:67 with 67 = e read from the page
#  M  evelyn-img-seg  141 = de by the same segmentation (the print glosses the whole word over 141)
#  M  evelyn-img-span the page shows the gloss spanning groups (Southampton over 356 84 ...) or a bare figure after it (nor over 269, 17 bare)
#  I  evelyn-img-H.   the page prints 'H.'; Hertford is the expansion
# The page prints letter groups inside the figure lines ('in', 'no', 'or', 'p', 'at', 'ad', 'if'): 'or' and 'p' carry a and t of Cabinet,
# so they are not OCR garbles; whether they are the 1857 printer's misreadings of figures is logged in HYPOTHESES.md, not resolved here.
# Counts after this pass: C 37, H 22, M 4, I 3 (66 rows); image-confirmed rows 38 vs 20 value-shuffled keys mean 0.50 max 2.
